blend.description: Team metrics = w·current season + (1−w)·prior season, w = games played / (games played + 4); each unit rating then blends toward the Elo-derived program strength with weight 0.12 + 0.33·(1−w).

proxies.talent: Program strength 1-10 = 5.5 + 1.6 × z-score of the latest CFBD Elo among FBS teams.
proxies.pbwr: Pass-block win rate proxy = 0.82 − 1.6 × (sacks + hurries allowed) / dropbacks, ± 0.01 per talent point.
proxies.prwr: Pass-rush win rate proxy = 0.26 + 1.3 × (sacks + hurries) / opponent dropbacks; per player from sacks and forced fumbles per game.
proxies.tprr: Targets per route run proxy = targets / (team dropbacks × estimated snap share).
proxies.snapPct: Snap shares are role-based estimates (college feeds publish no snap counts).
proxies.slotEfficiency: Offense EPA per target on throws ≤ 10 air yards.
proxies.nickelCorner: Defense EPA allowed per target on WR throws ≤ 10 air yards (inverted).
proxies.lbCoverage: Defense EPA allowed per target to TEs and RBs (inverted).
proxies.halftimeAdjust: 2nd-half minus 1st-half EPA/play margin, shrunk toward league average.
proxies.blitzRate: Not charted for college — 0.18 + 0.9 × havoc rate stands in for defensive aggression.
proxies.playActionRate: Not charted for college — curated per team (default 24%).
proxies.baseCoverage: Not available from free sources — curated per team in src/data/curated.ts.

notes: ESPN depth charts unavailable — depth charts ordered by play-by-play usage and roster class.
85 games against non-FBS opponents are not on the slate (no profile for the FCS side).
